segments.name: Acquisition and development of small molecule therapeutics
segments.description: Develops novel small molecule therapeutics for serious diseases with unmet medical needs, focusing on neurological and metabolic disorders.
segments.evidence: The Company operates in a single operating segment – the acquisition and development of small molecule therapeutics for the treatment of serious diseases with unmet medical needs.

revenueModel.text: The company generates revenues from cost of services related to development activities, though it does not have approved products for commercial sale.
revenueModel.evidence: we do not have any products that are approved for commercial sale and do not expect to generate any revenues from product sales for the foreseeable future, if ever
